text:
They request at least 3 recommendations from Israelis. It's a technical requirement that they need to mark as received. I believe that they can eventually make an exception if you don't know many Israelis, but I'd do my best to avoid it, so the process could go as smooth as possible. It's one of the things that they actually read when i used to submit my documents (along with photos and personal letter, that's what they always focused on).

Don't be shy about asking your landlord again, tell them that it's just a few sentences, and you can come to them when they are comfortable, and write it together. 

What about your lawyer? Maybe s/he can write something as well.

Personally I would even ask a friendly neighbor that we see often, invite them to dinner, explain the situation, and request to write how they've constantly seeing us together in the building, about the visit, etc.
